item_name: Rothco Women's Lace Trimmed Camo Camisole
item_short_desc: Rothco’s Womens Lace Trimmed Camisole features a soft fabric printed with our popular woodland camo pattern. The V-neck style camisole is trimmed with black lace that continues all the way around to meet in the back; the straps are easily adjusted for a custom fit.
